AI Companies Plan Joint Safety Group Amid Growing Concerns

Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic are reportedly planning to form a joint AI safety group in response to increasing concerns about artificial intelligence. Separately, OpenAI is expected to unveil a GPT-6 Cyber model and a product to aid its deployment. Other developments in the AI space include a new, inexpensive AI model challenging OpenAI and Anthropic, and Elon Musk's claim that SpaceX's AI model may surpass those of Anthropic and OpenAI within six months. Additionally, the White House has reportedly asked OpenAI and Anthropic to withhold models from British testers.
